title: The Last Brass Plate
request: Use np.arange with first, last and step to number the shelf plates, including last when a step lands there. Run checks changing inputs, so use these variables instead of fixed numbers.
objective: The stop is excluded: use last + 1 to allow the last plate.
starter:
import numpy as np
plates = np.arange(first, last + 1, 1)
deliver(plates)
hints: Use first, last and step with np.arange so the answer changes with the inputs; allow last by adding 1 to the stop.
Use np.arange(first, last + 1, step); np.arange excludes its stop value.
Write plates = np.arange(first, ___ + 1, step), then deliver(plates).
inputCode:
import random
first = random.randint(0, 8)
last = first + random.randint(2, 18)
step = random.randint(1, 4)
reference:
import numpy as np
plates = np.arange(first, last + 1, step)
deliver(plates)

naive.code:
import numpy as np
deliver(np.arange(first, last, step))
